name: Sheet Editor
description: Read and edit Excel (.xlsx) files on your phone: cells and formulas, number formats, rows and columns, sorting and filters. Opens files straight from other apps, keeps a draft of your edits, and works offline.

workflowSuggestions.title: Bảng tính Excel
